metadata.title: Heritage at Risk - 3D models
metadata.description: Curated sites with a public 3D model (laser scan, photogrammetry or reconstruction). Context layer, no threat score. is_whs=false marks destroyed non-WHS icons (e.g. Old City of Mosul).
metadata.sources: CyArk / Open Heritage 3D, Sketchfab (Global Digital Heritage, Tech 4 Heritage, arck-project, Rekrei)

properties.name: Abu Simbel (Great Temple)
properties.author: v777
properties.note: Model of the rock-cut Great Temple of Ramesses II (Nubian Monuments WHS)

properties.name: Babylon
properties.author: CyArk
properties.note: Laser-scan documentation of the Ishtar Gate and temples (2009)

properties.name: Giza Pyramid Complex
properties.author: Arqueomodel3D
properties.note: Photogrammetry of the three pyramids of Giza (part of the Memphis Pyramid Fields WHS)

properties.name: Hegra - Qasr al-Farid (Mada'in Salih)
properties.author: Novxlab
properties.note: Photogrammetry of Qasr al-Farid the iconic unfinished Nabataean tomb at Hegra

properties.name: Petra (Ad-Deir / The Monastery)
properties.author: CyArk
properties.note: 3D documentation of Ad-Deir (the Monastery), Petra's monumental rock-cut facade

properties.name: Site of Palmyra
properties.author: arck-project
properties.note: Collection of Palmyra monuments (Temple of Bel Roman Theatre Monumental Arch)

properties.name: Great Mosque of al-Nuri (Old City of Mosul)
properties.author: JuanAtelier
properties.note: Reconstruction of the 12th-c. mosque destroyed by IS in 2017 (not a WHS)

properties.name: Nimrud (Kalhu)
properties.author: Rekrei (Project Mosul)
properties.note: Crowdsourced reconstructions of Assyrian reliefs bulldozed by IS in 2015 (not a WHS)

properties.name: Nineveh
properties.author: Rekrei (Project Mosul)
properties.note: Reconstructed Mosul Museum artefacts from Nineveh (not a WHS)
